items.title: Carl Rinker Interview, 1962-10-14
items.q: I played in some ballroom with him a little bit. It wasn't much of a job. I think it was two or three nights a week and it lasted a little while. And Wingy was in front of the band

ctx.x: moved in. Did you mention that Wingy had a rehearsal band? Well he had several rehearsal bands. One of them

I was in and I think Max Kaminsky was the other trumpet in it. I think Marty Marcel was the other trumpet at one time. Floyd O'Brien was in it. Uh I think uh uh most everybody was in it that was around and once in a while we'd play a job sometimes we wouldn't. Wingy had uh a job in that ballroom at uh Sheffield and uh Belmont. Uh did he have that job in this period? About that time. Yeah. But I wasn't in the band. I don't think I may have been. Come to think of it I did play there or some play. I played in some…
